 Lens target points at Club Bruges as Lille bid to kick-start against Galatasaray 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Lens visit Club Bruges on Wednesday at 21:00 seeking to build their Champions League tally, while Lille host Galatasaray at 18:45 needing a first result.
 According to Le Progres, Lens aim to move on from last week’s 2-0 home defeat by Sporting Portugal, with captain Florian Thauvin in sparkling form on five goals and seven assists. He says his age and experience make leadership a responsibility he enjoys, a role first embraced at Udinese.
 OneFootball Videos
 Coach Yannick Cahuzac lauded Thauvin after Saturday’s 3-1 Ligue 1 win at Troyes and played down any notion of over-reliance, with the playmaker involved in eight of Lens’s 10 matches this season.
 Bruges represent a serious test. They won 4-3 at Inter Milan last week, driven by a Nicolo Tresoldi hat-trick, and beat Marseille 3-0 and Monaco 4-1 at home last season.
 Lille have lost their first two group games and must spark their campaign against Galatasaray or risk qualification hopes fading with Bayern Munich or AS Rome to come. Defender Alexsandro noted with a smile that six matches remain and imagined winning all six.
 Alongside Nathan Ngoy, Alexsandro has conceded only three goals in five Ligue 1 outings when paired, though Lille have shipped six in two in Europe. He said the Champions League brings greater intensity and stronger opponents, and expects combative duels with Galatasaray striker Victor Osimhen .
 Osimhen, 27, scored 18 goals for Lille in 2019-2020, has not yet netted in this season’s Champions League, but has six in the league in Türkiye. With both teams also chasing first points in a meeting of the 34th and 35th in the league phase, Davide Ancelotti expects a good match against experienced names such as Ilkay Gündogan, Leroy Sané and Lucas Torreira.
 Source: Le Progres
